description_en: Adds multiple DNS records in batches and supports various record types
description_zh: 批量添加DNS解析记录，支持多种记录类型
name: BatchCreateRecords

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain the site ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

fields.help_en: The AccessKey of the account to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is required when the origin server type is OSS and the origin server authentication type is private cross-account read, or when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server authentication type is private read
fields.help_zh: 源站所属账号的AccessKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时，需要填写此值
fields.name: access_key

fields.help_en:
The origin server authentication type. Different origin server types support different authentication types. The origin server type refers to the SourceType parameter in this operation. This parameter is required when the origin server type is OSS or S3. Valid values:
public: public read. Select this value when the origin server type is OSS or S3 and the origin server is publicly readable.
private: private read. Select this value when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server is privately readable.
private_same_account: private read within the same account. Select this value when the origin server type is OSS, the origin server and the current resource belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account, and the origin server is privately readable.
private_cross_account: private read across accounts. Select this value when the origin server type is OSS, the origin server and the current resource belong to different Alibaba Cloud accounts, and the origin server is privately readable
fields.help_zh:
源站鉴权类型，不同的源站类型，支持的鉴权类型不同，源站类型是指本接口中的SourceType参数，现在源站类型为OSS和S3时，需要填写源站鉴权类型，可选值：
public：公共读，当源站类型为OSS或S3，且源站为公共读时，选此值。
private: 私有读，当源站类型为S3，且源站为私有读时，选此值。
private_same_account: 私有同账号读，当源站类型为OSS，在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时，选此值。
private_cross_account: 私有跨账号读，当源站类型为OSS，不在同一个阿里云账号下，且源站为私有读时，选此值
fields.name: auth_type

fields.help_en: The region to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is required when the origin server type is S3. You can obtain the region of the origin server from the official website of S3
fields.help_zh: 源站所属区域，当源站类型为S3时，需要填写此值，源站所属的区域需要在S3的官方网站上获取
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The SecretKey of the account to which the origin server belongs. This parameter is required when the origin server type is OSS and the origin server authentication type is private cross-account read, or when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server authentication type is private read
fields.help_zh: 源站所属账号的SecretKey，当源站类型为OSS且源站鉴权类型为私有跨账号读，或者源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时，需要填写此值
fields.name: secret_key

fields.help_en:
The version of the signature algorithm. This parameter is available when the origin server type is S3 and the origin server authentication type is private read. Valid values:
v2
v4

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is v4
fields.help_zh:
签名算法版本，当源站类型为S3且源站鉴权类型为私有读时有该参数，支持以下两种：
v2
v4

不传时，默认为v4
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The origin server authentication information of the CNAME record
fields.help_zh: CNAME记录的源站鉴权信息
fields.name: auth_conf

fields.help_en:
The business scenario when the record is accelerated. Valid values:
image_video: videos and images.
api: API operations.
web: web pages
fields.help_zh:
记录加速时的业务场景，取值：
image_video：视频图片。
api：api接口。
web：web网页
fields.name: biz_name

fields.help_en: The encryption algorithm used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to CERT and SSHFP records
fields.help_zh: 记录所采用的加密算法，范围为0~255。适用于CERT、SSHFP记录
fields.name: algorithm

fields.help_en: The public key certificate information of the record. This parameter applies to CERT, SMIMEA, and TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录的公钥证书信息。适用于CERT、SMIMEA和TLSA记录
fields.name: certificate

fields.help_en: The public key fingerprint value of the record. This parameter applies to SSHFP records
fields.help_zh: 记录的公钥指纹值。适用于SSHFP记录
fields.name: fingerprint

fields.help_en: The flag of the CAA record, which indicates its priority and processing method. Valid values: 0 to 255
fields.help_zh: CAA记录的标志位，指示其优先级和处理方式，取值范围为0~255
fields.name: flag

fields.help_en: The public key identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter applies to CERT records
fields.help_zh: 记录的公钥标识，范围为0~65535。适用于CERT记录
fields.name: key_tag

fields.help_en: The algorithm policy used by the record to match or verify the certificate. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to SMIMEA and TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录用于匹配或验证证书的算法策略，范围为0~255。适用于SMIMEA和TLSA记录
fields.name: matching_type

fields.help_en: The port of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter applies only to SRV records
fields.help_zh: 记录的端口，范围为0~65535。仅适用于SRV记录
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The priority of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. This parameter is required when you add MX, SRV, or URI records
fields.help_zh: 记录的优先级，范围为0~65535。数值越小，优先级越高。添加MX、SRV、URI记录时，该参数必填
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The type of the certificate or public key used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to SMIMEA and TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录所使用的证书或公钥的类型，范围为0~255。适用于SMIMEA和TLSA记录
fields.name: selector

fields.help_en: The tag of the CAA record, which indicates its specific type and usage, such as issue, issuewild, and iodef
fields.help_zh: CAA记录的标签，表示其具体类型和用途，如issue、issuewild、iodef等
fields.name: tag

fields.help_en: The certificate type for CERT records or the public key type for SSHFP records
fields.help_zh: 记录的证书类型（CERT记录）或公钥类型（SSHFP记录）
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The usage identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to SMIMEA and TLSA records
fields.help_zh: 记录的用途标识，范围为0~255。适用于SMIMEA和TLSA记录
fields.name: usage

fields.help_en:
The record value or partial content.
A/AAAA: an IP address.
CNAME: the target domain name to which the record points.
MX: a valid target mail server domain name.
TXT: a valid text character string.
CAA: a valid certificate issuing authority domain name.
SRV: a valid target host domain name.
URI: a valid URI string
fields.help_zh:
记录值或部分内容。
A/AAAA：IP。
CNAME：指向的目标域名。
MX: 有效的目标邮件服务器域名。
TXT：有效的文本字符串。
CAA：有效的证书颁发机构域名。
SRV：有效的目标主机域名。
URI: 有效的 URI 字符串
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The weight of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter applies to SRV and URI records
fields.help_zh: 记录的权重，范围为0~65535。适用于SRV、URI记录
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The DNS information of the record. Specify different fields based on the record type
fields.help_zh: 记录的DNS信息，根据记录类型填写不同的字段
fields.name: data

fields.help_en: The HTTP port. By default, port 80 is supported
fields.help_zh: HTTP 端口，默认支持 80 端口
fields.name: http_ports

fields.help_en: The HTTPS port. By default, port 443 is supported
fields.help_zh: HTTPS端口，默认支持443端口
fields.name: https_ports

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable proxy acceleration for the record. Only CNAME records and A/AAAA records can enable proxy acceleration. Valid values:
true: enables proxy acceleration.
false: disables proxy acceleration
fields.help_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速。只有CNAME记录与A/AAAA记录可以开启代理加速。取值：
true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速
fields.name: proxied

fields.help_en: The name of the record
fields.help_zh: 记录名称
fields.name: record_name

fields.help_en:
The origin server type of the CNAME record. This parameter is required when you add a CNAME record. Valid values:

OSS: an OSS origin server.
S3: an S3 origin server.
LB: a load balancing origin server.
OP: an origin address pool origin server.
Domain: a common domain name origin server.

If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the default value is Domain, which indicates a common domain name origin server
fields.help_zh:
CNAME记录的源站类型。添加CNAME记录时，需要填写此参数。取值：

OSS：OSS源站。
S3：S3源站。
LB：负载均衡器源站。
OP：源地址池源站。
Domain：普通域名源站。

该参数不传或传空时，则默认为Domain，即普通域名源站类型
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en: The time-to-live (TTL) of the record, in seconds. A value of 1 indicates that the TTL is automatically determined
fields.help_zh: 记录的过期时间，单位秒。当取值为1时，表示记录的过期时间为自动
fields.name: ttl

fields.help_en: The DNS type of the record
fields.help_zh: 记录的DNS类型
fields.name: type

Data.description_en: The DNS information of the record, including the values and related attributes of various record types
Data.description_zh: 记录的DNS信息，包含各种类型的记录值及其相关属性

Algorithm.description_en: The encryption algorithm used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to CERT and SSHFP records
Algorithm.description_zh: 记录所采用的加密算法，范围为0~255。适用于CERT、SSHFP记录

Certificate.description_en: The public key certificate information of the record. This parameter applies to CERT, SMIMEA, and TLSA records
Certificate.description_zh: 记录的公钥证书信息。适用于CERT、SMIMEA和TLSA记录

Fingerprint.description_en: The public key fingerprint value of the record. This parameter applies to SSHFP records
Fingerprint.description_zh: 记录的公钥指纹值。适用于SSHFP记录

Flag.description_en: The flag of the record. It indicates the priority and processing method, and applies to CAA records
Flag.description_zh: 记录的标志位。指示其优先级和处理方式，使用于CAA记录

KeyTag.description_en: The public key identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. This parameter applies to CERT records
KeyTag.description_zh: 记录的公钥标识，范围为0~65535。适用于CERT记录

MatchingType.description_en: The algorithm policy used by the record to match or verify the certificate. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to SMIMEA and TLSA records
MatchingType.description_zh: 记录用于匹配或验证证书的算法策略，范围为0~255。适用于SMIMEA和TLSA记录

Port.description_en: The port number of the record. It is associated with SRV records and applies only to SRV records
Port.description_zh: 记录的端口号，与SRV记录关联。仅适用于SRV记录

Priority.description_en: The priority of the record. Valid values: 0 to 65535. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. This parameter applies to MX, SRV, and URI records
Priority.description_zh: 记录的优先级，范围为 0~65535。数值越小，优先级越高。适用于MX、SRV、URI记录

Selector.description_en: The type of the certificate or public key used by the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to SMIMEA and TLSA records
Selector.description_zh: 记录所使用的证书或公钥的类型，范围为0~255。适用于SMIMEA和TLSA记录

Tag.description_en: The tag of the CAA record. It indicates the specific type and purpose, such as issue, issuewild, or iodef
Tag.description_zh: CAA记录的标签，表示其具体类型和用途，如issue、issuewild、iodef

Type.description_en: The certificate type for CERT records or the public key type for SSHFP records
Type.description_zh: 记录的证书类型（CERT记录）或公钥类型（SSHFP记录）

Usage.description_en: The usage identifier of the record. Valid values: 0 to 255. This parameter applies to SMIMEA and TLSA records
Usage.description_zh: 记录的用途标识，范围为0~255。适用于SMIMEA和TLSA记录

Value.description_en:
The record value or partial content. This parameter is included in A/AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV, and URI records. It has different meanings in different record types:

A/AAAA: The target IP address. Separate multiple IP addresses with half-width comma characters (,). At least one IPv4 address is required.
CNAME: The target domain name.
NS: The name server of the specified domain name.
MX: The valid domain name of the target mail server.
TXT: The valid text character string.
CAA: The valid domain name of the certificate issuing authority.
SRV: The valid domain name of the target host.
URI: The valid URI character string
Value.description_zh:
记录值或部分内容。A/AAAA、CNAME、NS、MX、TXT、CAA、SRV、URI记录中含有该参数。在不同类型的记录中，分别表示不同的含义：

A/AAAA：指向的ip地址。多个ip时，用半角逗号,分隔。至少需要有一个ipv4地址。
CNAME：指向的目标域名。
NS：指定域名的名称服务器。
MX:  有效的目标邮件服务器域名。
TXT：有效的文本字符串。
CAA：有效的证书颁发机构域名。
SRV：有效的目标主机域名。
URI: 有效的 URI 字符串

Weight.description_en: The weight of the record. This parameter applies to SRV and URI records
Weight.description_zh: 记录的权重。适用于SRV、URI记录

HttpPorts.description_en: The HTTP port. By default, port 80 is supported
HttpPorts.description_zh: HTTP 端口，默认支持 80 端口

HttpsPorts.description_en: The HTTPS port. Port 443 is supported by default
HttpsPorts.description_zh: HTTPS 端口，默认支持 443 端口

Proxied.description_en:
Indicates whether proxy acceleration is enabled for the record. Only CNAME and A/AAAA records support proxy acceleration. Valid values:

true: Proxy acceleration is enabled.
false: Proxy acceleration is disabled
Proxied.description_zh:
记录是否开启代理加速。只有CNAME记录与A/AAAA记录可以开启代理加速。取值：

true：开启代理。
false：关闭代理加速
